title: Cushman & Wakefield Earns Upgrade to ‘Ba3’ Rating from Moody’s Ratings, Outlook Stable
summary: NEW YORK, September 28, 2026--Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE: CWK), a leading global commercial real estate services firm, announced today that Moody’s Ratings ("Moody’s") upgraded CWK’s corporate family rating to Ba3 from B1. The upgrade reflects sustained improvement in the company’s credit profile and is the highest rating Moody’s has assigned to Cushman & Wakefield since its initial public offering in 2018.
